abertura: Many teams have a short meeting every week where each person gives an update.
Three of these sentences are true. Mark the three.

itens.t: Each person usually speaks for a short time.
itens.porque: A check-in is short. Everyone needs time to speak.

itens.t: You explain everything you did every day of the week.
itens.porque: The team needs the main points: where the work is, and what comes next.

itens.t: People can ask questions after an update.
itens.porque: Questions are part of the check-in. They help the team plan.

itens.t: You have to know the answer to every question.
itens.porque: Nobody knows everything. You can say when you will check.

itens.t: It is a good moment to say what you need from others.
itens.porque: The people who can help are in the meeting.

itens.t: Only the manager gives an update.
itens.porque: In a check-in, each person on the team gives one.

sec1.pt: Muitas equipes têm uma reunião curta toda semana em que cada pessoa dá uma atualização. Marque as três frases verdadeiras.

alts: the last thing you finished

itens.ok: the thing you need to do after this

itens.t: on track
alts: going as planned, with no delay
finished early
itens.ok: going as planned, with no delay

itens.t: behind schedule
alts: ahead of the plan
later than the plan

itens.t: to get back to someone
alts: to answer them later, when you have the information
to go back to their office
itens.ok: to answer them later, when you have the information

itens.t: on my side
alts: about the part of the work I do
next to me in the room
itens.ok: about the part of the work I do

sec2.pt: Escolha o sentido que cada expressão tem numa atualização de trabalho. Você pode usar essas expressões na aula.

doc.texto:
1. Updates: the sales director, the service director, and you.
2. New laptops for the sales team: next steps.
3. New office hours from next Monday.
4. Questions and next week’s plan.

Please bring: the status of your work, the next step, and anything you need from the team.

abertura: Read the agenda. Three of these sentences are true. Mark the three.

itens.t: You give an update in this meeting.
itens.porque: Point 1: “Updates: the sales director, the service director, and you.”

itens.t: The meeting is on Friday.
itens.porque: It is on Monday at 9:00.

itens.t: The team talks about the laptops.
itens.porque: Point 2: “New laptops for the sales team: next steps.”

itens.t: There is no time for questions.
itens.porque: Point 4 is questions and next week’s plan.

itens.t: People should say what they need from the team.
itens.porque: “Please bring: … anything you need from the team.”

itens.t: Only the CEO speaks.
itens.porque: Three people give updates, and there is time for questions.

sec3.pt: Leia a pauta da reunião e marque as três frases verdadeiras.

sec4.pt: Olhe de novo a pauta da atividade 3 e escolha o final que combina com o que ela pede para a atualização.

sec5.titulo: What goes in a short update
abertura: You have a short time for your update. Decide what goes in and what stays out.

itens.t: what is finished
itens.porque: It tells the team the status of your work.

itens.t: every email you sent this week
itens.porque: It is too much detail for a short update.

itens.t: the next step
itens.porque: The team needs to know what comes next.

itens.t: the full story of the project from the start
itens.porque: The team already knows it. Say what changed.

itens.t: a problem that changes a date
itens.porque: A new date can change other people's work.

itens.t: the names of everyone in your department
itens.porque: The team knows who works there. Say only who you need something from.

sec5.pt: Você tem pouco tempo para a sua atualização. Decida o que entra e o que fica de fora.

abertura: Write notes for an update on something you are working on.

callout.texto:
Where is the work now? What is the next step? What do you need from other people?

Write notes, not full sentences. You can change names and numbers. You can use your notes in your lesson.

sec6.pt:
Escreva anotações para uma atualização sobre algo em que você está trabalhando.

Em que ponto está o trabalho? Qual é o próximo passo? O que você precisa de outras pessoas? Escreva anotações, não frases completas. Você pode trocar nomes e números, e pode usar as anotações na aula.

itens.t: I am not sure yet. I will check with the supplier and tell you today.
itens.porque: Paula does not get the date, but she knows when she will get it.

itens.t: I don't know.
itens.porque: Nobody knows what happens next, so someone has to ask again.

itens.t: I do not have the date now. Can I send it to you after the meeting?
itens.porque: It offers a next step and a moment, and asks if that is OK.

itens.t: Maybe Tuesday. Or Friday. I am not sure.
itens.porque: Two guesses and no plan. Paula cannot use either date.

itens.t: Good question. Let me check with Ryan and get back to you by the end of the day.
itens.porque: It says who you will check with and when you will answer.

itens.t: That is not my problem.
itens.porque: It gives no information, and no next step.

rp4.rationale: Three replies say what you will do and when. Three leave Paula with nothing to plan with.

itens.t: Is the new system on all the laptops?
alts: Yes, on nineteen. One still has a problem with the screen.
Yes, the system is on all the laptops, and they all work.
No, Nora did not install the system on the laptops.
itens.ok: Yes, on nineteen. One still has a problem with the screen.
itens.porque: It answers and adds the detail the team needs: one laptop still has a problem.

itens.t: Are we on track for Thursday?
alts: Thursday is the day of the training for the sales team.
We are behind schedule, so the training is on Thursday.
Yes, we are on track, but I need the supplier to answer today.
itens.ok: Yes, we are on track, but I need the supplier to answer today.
itens.porque: It gives the status and what is needed to keep it.

itens.t: How much does a new laptop cost?
alts: It is expensive, but I am not sure how much it is.
I don't have the price. I will check and get back to you by tomorrow.
The supplier has a lot of laptops in the warehouse.
itens.ok: I don't have the price. I will check and get back to you by tomorrow.
itens.porque: When you do not know, you say so, and you say when you will answer.

itens.t: Do you need anything from us?
alts: Yes. I need the sales team to use one old laptop this week.
No, thank you. Everything is fine with the laptops.
Yes. The supplier needs to call the sales team.
itens.ok: Yes. I need the sales team to use one old laptop this week.
itens.porque: It says what you need and from whom. One laptop is still not working, so everything is not fine.

lessonrecap.pt:
Resumo da aula.

A situação: a sua atualização no check-in semanal, com a Paula e os outros diretores fazendo perguntas. A tabela reúne como dizer em que ponto está o trabalho, qual é o próximo passo, o que você precisa e o que dizer quando você ainda não sabe, além do vocabulário-chave.

O que você fez nesta aula: você deu uma atualização antes de ver qualquer modelo, ouviu a atualização de um colega, encontrou respostas que mantêm a reunião andando quando você não sabe a resposta, e deu a sua atualização de novo, com perguntas e uma mudança de data.
